P_0x00E82D.en: Read as "Hou." A beast-immortal (fox immortal) of Baral. Once saved by Taihou, she has followed him as her teacher ever since. She serves as Baral's information gatherer, using summoning talismans to call forth and command demonic mechanical beings. Calm and gentle in manner. Full name: Houkason.

P_0x00E9A9.en: A pilot among the Neue DC remnants. He once took part in Operation Plantagenet alongside Van Ba Chun, leader of the Neue DC, and was scarred on the face during an Einst attack in that operation.

P_0x00EABE.en: A mercenary hired by Isurugi Heavy Industries. Even in battle he shows no hatred or hostility, fighting with cool detachment, but at heart he is cold-blooded and cruel.

P_0x00EB6B.en: A member of the Schtedonias Army's special operations unit and Zamboss's adjutant.

P_0x00EBCC.en: Alteur Steinbeck's true identity. A member of an alien faction called the "Ze Balmar Empire Inspection Army"; he once dropped <Meteor 3> on Earth and sent the automated planet Nebulaseem into the solar system.

P_0x00ECE9.en: Chief strategist of the Feil Army. A capable man, though a bit of a nag.

P_0x00ED4C.en: High priest of the Holy Kingdom of Langran, who gave the coronation address.

P_0x00EDB6.en: Commander of the <Earth Fed Army>'s 3rd Orbital Patrol Squadron. Rare among space force officers for having become a captain despite being Earth-born. Disapproves of specialized units like the Steel Dragon Squadron.
